title: Grand Coding Challenge (25 Outputs)
description:
Complete all 5 sequential programming challenges (25 total outputs):
1. Use a for loop to print numbers 1 to 5.
2. Use a loop to print the squares (n * n) of numbers 1 to 5.
3. For numbers 1 to 5, print "Even" if n % 2 == 0 else "Odd".
4. Define a function double_val(x) returning x * 2, and print double_val(n) for n = 1..5.
5. Loop over list ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"] and print each letter.
